name: Twist
description: Twist is an asynchronous team communication platform organized around workspaces, channels, topic-focused threads, comments, and an inbox.
agentUseSummary: Connect one user through Relay's confidential Twist General Integration with exact user/workspace/channel/thread/comment read scopes. Relay exposes five fixed bounded reads for the connected user, workspaces, channels, recent inbox threads, and one thread with recent comments; direct messages, search, files, webhooks, bots, raw API access, and every mutation remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: TWIST_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Twist client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway-held production Twist General Integration client ID.

credentialRequirements.name: TWIST_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Twist client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway-encrypted confidential client secret; never returned to clients or agents.

capabilities.label: Read connected user
capabilities.description: Verify the exact OAuth-authorized Twist user.

capabilities.label: List workspaces
capabilities.description: List at most twenty workspaces available to the connected user.

capabilities.label: List channels
capabilities.description: List at most fifty channels in one explicit workspace.

capabilities.label: List inbox threads
capabilities.description: List at most twenty recent active inbox threads in one explicit workspace.

capabilities.label: Read thread comments
capabilities.description: Read one explicit thread with at most thirty recent comments.

allowed.label: Read connected user
allowed.description: Return the bound Twist user's useful identity fields.

allowed.label: List workspaces
allowed.description: Return at most twenty workspace IDs and human-readable names.

allowed.label: List workspace channels
allowed.description: Return at most fifty useful channels for one numeric workspace ID.

allowed.label: List inbox threads
allowed.description: Return at most twenty recent active inbox threads with useful titles, content, authorship, and timestamps.

allowed.label: Read thread with comments
allowed.description: Return one numeric thread and at most thirty recent comments with bounded useful content.

blocked.label: Block mutations
blocked.description: Thread, comment, channel, workspace, message, reaction, notification, membership, and administration mutations are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block sensitive reads
blocked.description: Direct messages, conversations, attachments, notifications, groups, and broad member data are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block broad and raw access
blocked.description: Global search, cursors, pagination, bulk export, webhooks, bots, update integrations, arbitrary endpoints, and raw API access are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Read only
approvalProfiles.description: Only five fixed bounded Twist reads are enabled.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts the same five fixed bounded Twist read wrappers for OpenClaw without exposing OAuth credentials.
Railway mounts the same five fixed bounded Twist read wrappers for Hermes without exposing OAuth credentials.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's production Twist General Integration, exact Railway callback registration, credentials, distribution review, authorized backend deployment, and real connected-user lifecycle evidence are not available.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create and approve the production General Integration, register the exact Railway callback, configure TWIST_CLIENT_ID and TWIST_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, then deploy and run consent, user binding, bounded semantic reads, remove-integration, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial acceptance.

evidence.supports: Twist documents production General Integration OAuth authorization-code flow, exact comma-separated scopes, confidential token exchange, bearer API access, and granular read/write/remove permissions.
The API documents useful user, workspace, channel, inbox, thread, and comment objects and separate messages/search/attachment/write scopes excluded from V1.
Twist directs production integrations through OAuth and identifies its full-scope personal integration token as development-only.
Twist provides an upstream user-facing Remove integration flow; the API does not document a narrow per-installation revocation endpoint for Relay to call.
